title: Allow --reason on relay-run end --close-steps fail
lead: `slicer relay-run end RUN --outcome stopped --close-steps fail --reason TEXT` records TEXT as the reason on every step it closes as failed, as `relay-run step --phase fail --reason` does for one step.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a reason on the run itself or on its end event, `--reason` with `--close-steps done`, and any change to `relay-run step`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: s405 added `--reason` to `relay-run step --phase fail` so a vendor limit is recorded with its cause. When the outer session or ork stops a run, `relay-run end --close-steps fail` closes every running step as failed but cannot say why, so `relay-run list` shows failures with no reason. ork's TUI already suggests `slicer relay-run end RUN --outcome stopped --close-steps fail` (`../ork` `internal/tui/ledgerend.go:21`) and would pass the reason it knows.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py`: the `relay-run end` parser (next to `--close-steps`) and `cmd_relay_run_end`.
- `src/slicer/ops.py`: `relay_run_end` gains `reason: str = ""`, passes it through `relayrun.one_line("reason", ...)` and on to `relayrun.step_event(..., reason=reason)` for each closed step, as `relay_run_step` does.
- `tests/test_relay_run.py`.
- `docs/commands.md` (the `relay-run end` row), `CHANGELOG.md` under Added.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `test_RelayRunEnd_CloseStepsFailReason_RecordsReasonOnEachClosedStep`: two running steps, `end --outcome stopped --close-steps fail --reason "owner stopped"`; both steps read `phase` fail and `reason` "owner stopped" in `relay-run list --json`.
- `test_RelayRunEnd_ReasonWithoutCloseStepsFail_IsBadRunField`: `--reason` with no `--close-steps`, or with `--close-steps done`, exits with code `bad_run_field` and writes nothing.
- `test_RelayRunEnd_ReasonMultiLine_IsRefused`: a reason with a newline is refused like `step --reason`.
- `test_RelayRunEnd_CloseStepsFailNoReason_Unchanged`: without `--reason` the events are byte-identical to today.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests; watch them go red.
2. Add the flag and thread it through; validate before taking the ledger lock so a refusal writes nothing.
3. Update docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check each new test.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
